name: ether-ai
description: ETHER AI — assistant IA web open-source, franc et sans complaisance (Cloudflare Workers)

scripts.lint: for f in renderer/*.js sw.js worker/src/index.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.build:web: rm -rf worker/public && mkdir -p worker/public && cp -R index.html offline.html style.css marked.min.js manifest.webmanifest sw.js icons renderer _headers worker/public/
scripts.dev: npm run build:web && cd worker && npx wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: npm run build:web && cd worker && npx wrangler deploy

author: fharzallah
